responsibility: This is the main implementation file of the NDS32 GCC backend. It owns the target hook definitions and core target behavior for code generation, including option and attribute handling, ABI/calling-convention logic, register allocation policy, prologue/epilogue and stack layout decisions, address legitimacy and constant handling, assembler output hooks, builtin hookup, TLS/PIC and section behavior, ISR integration, and registration of machine-dependent passes such as relax-opt and fp-as-gp. It is the central hook-and-policy body that ties together the NDS32 headers, auxiliary source files, and machine descriptions into a complete GCC target.
same_name_distinction: Within the nds32 same-name set, this C source is the executable backend implementation and target-hook body: it defines hook functions, builtin integration, register/ABI policies, assembler output helpers, and initializes targetm, whereas nds32.h provides shared target macros/types, nds32.md provides RTL instruction patterns, and nds32.opt declares command-line options.
